system.description:
You can move water against its natural inclinations or change its state of matter. You may alter a quantity of water that could fit into a cubical space 100 ft. on each side, though the amount need not be confined to such dimensions. This incantation can freeze the surface of a pond or river for easy passage, empty the contents of a well, or hold aside waves such that a sunken wreck near the shore might be investigated. When the incantation unravels, the water resumes obeisance of natural laws: water held in place will come crashing into any available vacuum, and ice will start to melt.

The effect lasts 10 minutes (1 dungeon action). Each spark either doubles the duration or the quantity of water affected.
